_note: Layer 2 hiring pipeline: role-family taxonomy. A job title is matched against the families IN ORDER; the first family whose pattern matches wins. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regexes. Edit this file to add or rename families (hiring history is stored by family id). Built 2026-10-17 from the Layer 2 job-posting keyword table (cooling, photonics, memory, custom silicon, quantum, space, power) plus the roles that became popular in 2024-2026 (forward deployed engineer, AI engineer, ML engineer).
